name: Hextris
ready_js: typeof window.score === 'number' && typeof window.MainHex === 'object' && typeof window.gameState === 'number'
state_js: ({score: window.score, gameState: window.gameState, sides: window.MainHex.blocks.map(side => side.map(b => ({color: b.color, deleted: b.deleted})))})
controls: Click the central play button to start. Left and right arrows rotate the hexagon. Match three touching blocks of one colour to clear them. Down speeds falling blocks. P pauses. Enter restarts.
goal: Clear a group of at least three blocks of one colour and reach a score of at least 9.
notes: Run python -m tools.fetch_games first. GPLv3 game, downloaded for local play only and never shipped in git. Reads score, gameState and MainHex without changing game files. Random blocks and no replay frame counter: reports show Not reproducible and recordings use real time. Browser proof within about 40 steps is owed. Upstream includes remote ads, analytics and fonts; use --offline with a local model to block these requests. The offline flag also blocks the paid model service.
